scope: Final equal-depth verification for a Rímac bridge/street axis, Lima's long pedestrian-commercial spine, and a community-governed Shipibo-Konibo urban settlement where collaboration and consent are absolute prerequisites.

sources.supports: A July 2025 municipal record documents renewed sidewalks/cycle infrastructure beginning at Jirón Trujillo and linking the historic Rímac axis to contemporary inclusive mobility.
UNESCO documentation records community maintenance/learning along Jirón Trujillo and its historic-industrial fabric; it is historical, not a 2026 condition report.

Secondary resource description supplies bridge structure and its connection between Rímac/Jirón Trujillo and the Jirón de la Unión continuation; current condition/safety require primary field verification.
The current national inventory records Jirón de la Unión as a nine-block pedestrian commercial spine supporting walking, commerce, photography, religious and cultural activities.
A January 2026 historical walk gathered more than 400 people and used present street space to locate remembered/lost cultural addresses.
July 2026 municipal coverage documents temporary parade/performance occupation; the search listing is a discovery/currentity signal requiring exact-event-page confirmation before routing.
A June 2026 community-based intercultural justice/services campaign confirms current community presence and collective civic use.

sources.publisher: Ministerio de la Mujer y Poblaciones Vulnerables
sources.supports: A March 2026 visit documents women artisans' productive organization and cultural practices; official documentation does not grant independent photography consent.

sources.publisher: Ministerio de Vivienda, Construcción y Saneamiento
sources.supports: Historical official evidence documents housing plans blocked by contaminated/high-risk ground; these measurements must not be presented as current 2026 conditions.

contradictions: Current authoritative evidence verifies the renewed mobility axis beginning at Jirón Trujillo, not the 2026 condition of every historic-street segment or Puente de Piedra.
Bridge structure/current safety rests partly on a secondary record and requires primary same-day verification.
The combined street/bridge label must resolve to one visible crossing section, not a multi-frame heritage route.
composition_questions: Can one safe bridge/street position show historic Rímac alignment channeling today’s walking, cycling and metropolitan crossing?
Which skyline, bridge elevation, church façade, traffic or municipal-renewal detail turns the frame into heritage/infrastructure documentation?
Does one 35 mm public position connect Jirón Trujillo, bridge section and current movement, or must the combined candidate be split?

source_truth.answer: Jirón Trujillo is a lived historic Rímac axis connected to renewed inclusive-mobility infrastructure; Puente de Piedra continues the cross-river route, with exact current condition requiring field verification.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Historic street and masonry bridge organized movement between Rímac and central Lima across the river; the axis later accumulated industrial and metropolitan transport layers.

current_life.answer: People walk, cycle, drive, maintain, cross and connect to newer mobility infrastructure; bridge stopping, density and barriers require direct observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Walk, cycle, cross, clean, maintain, wait and merge are evidenced/credible. An empty bridge section may reveal layered infrastructure only with safe contemporary movement cues.

architectural_causality.answer: Historic alignment, bridge deck/railings, river/expressway section and renewed paths compress several eras of movement into one crossing.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Bridge elevation, churchward street vista and municipal before/after dominate. The underused relation is a safe ground-level section where current travel reveals temporal layering.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can separate stone/iron, river/expressway and pedestrian layers; lateral light can clarify bridge section. Skyline or patina without movement causality fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test safe bridge-approach section, Jirón Trujillo axis and river/transport reverse. Start 35 mm for layered crossing, 50 mm for merge and avoid 85 mm skyline isolation.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify railings, works and safe stopping; never step into traffic or block narrow paths, protect vendors/residents, cap waits and reject any angle needing unsafe river/expressway access.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when inherited crossing architecture visibly channels several present mobility systems. Historic vista, bridge portrait or caption-built route fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Safe public bridge approach holding street axis, deck/railing and river/transport section

B_HABITAR.position: Safe path junction where walkers/cyclists merge toward bridge
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Walk, cycle and merge occupy layers
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No faces, plates or vendor dominance

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public reverse from lived street toward bridge/renewed mobility, avoiding church skyline

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Safe oblique where stone/iron shadow meets pedestrian/cycle path

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Safe diagonal joining historic street approach, bridge and current mobility layers
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approach, merge and cross occupy layers

contradictions: The official inventory describes a nine-block spine; one photograph must select one block/threshold and cannot inherit the whole corridor's history.
A 2026 guided walk and parade are completed events, not recurring route windows.
Commercial density and storefronts vary block by block and require same-day observation.
composition_questions: Which one block or threshold makes the pedestrian spine visibly transform commerce, memory or civic performance into a present spatial relation?
Which centered vanishing point, dense crowd, heritage façade, street performer or shopping sign produces the standard Jirón de la Unión image?
Does a side/reverse camera position reveal a meaningful threshold or absence before the caption explains the lost address/event?

source_truth.answer: Jirón de la Unión is a current nine-block pedestrian-commercial cultural spine whose present uses include walking, commerce, worship, performance and guided memory.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A continuous central-city street linked major civic/religious nodes and concentrated commerce, sociability and procession along repeated urban thresholds.

current_life.answer: People walk, shop, sell, perform, worship, listen and locate vanished addresses; exact block rhythms and future events remain field-dependent.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Walk, browse, sell, queue, listen, perform, remember and cross are evidenced. An absent cultural address can work only if collective attention or spatial residue is visible.

architectural_causality.answer: Pedestrian continuity, narrow street section, repeated portals and civic-node approaches compress and redirect commerce, procession and memory.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Centered vanishing-point crowd, façade and street-performance coverage dominate. The underused relation is one lateral threshold where present use exposes continuity or loss.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify signage/façades and emphasize figure-ground; low light can reveal portal rhythm. Neon/commercial atmosphere without architectural cause fails.

position_then_optics.answer: At one selected block test lateral portal, cross-street section and reverse crowd flow. Start 35 mm for street/threshold, 50 mm for action and avoid 85 mm crowd compression without context.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Select one sourced block, verify crowd/security and events, protect vendors/worshippers/children, do not obstruct the pedestrian spine and leave if density prevents clean edges.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when one block's pedestrian architecture makes commerce, memory or civic action legible without corridor history. Generic crowd, façade or caption-led nostalgia fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: One selected cross-street/portal edge holding pedestrian section and repeated thresholds
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Avoid centered vanishing point and sign clutter

B_HABITAR.position: Lateral public threshold where walking turns into shopping/worship/entry
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No face, vendor or brand dominance

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public side/reverse view at one remembered/lost address, avoiding axial vista
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Group/individual attention pauses against present commerce

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Lateral public angle where portal/façade shadow crosses pedestrian stream

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: One public diagonal joining spine approach, selected threshold and present action/memory
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approach, pause and enter/listen occupy layers

contradictions: Current community presence and collective programs are verified, but no independent photography access or consent is established.
Historical contamination/risk and housing proposals cannot be presented as current measurements or completed solutions.
No collaboration/consent means no photograph; hidden telephoto, exoticized Kené and vulnerability imagery are prohibited fallbacks.
composition_questions: With community co-authorship, which collectively chosen space visibly enables a present civic, productive or care verb on the community’s own terms?
Which official-visit pose, exoticized pattern, poverty/risk cue or outsider overview extracts identity rather than showing architectural agency?
Would participants recognize the frame’s purpose, choose its position/use and approve its submission without needing the photographer’s caption to justify it?

source_truth.answer: Cantagallo remains an active Shipibo-Konibo urban community in Rímac with verified 2026 intercultural civic and women-led productive programs; access is community-governed.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Self-organized settlement and proposed housing/public-space systems respond to migration, fire and community continuity; no unbuilt proposal is described as existing architecture.

current_life.answer: Community members organize, make, teach, sing, meet, receive services and exercise governance; these acts are not photographable without participant-led collaboration.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Organize, make, teach, meet, advise, care, sing and govern are evidenced. Meaningful absence is valid only if participants select it and social structure remains legible.

architectural_causality.answer: A collaboratively selected community room, work surface, route or care/service threshold may organize collective action; no outsider may preselect a vulnerable domestic scene.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Official delegation, artisan portrait, Kené texture and vulnerability overview dominate. The acceptable alternative is community-authored spatial agency, not visual rarity.

light_material_geometry.answer: Light/material choices follow participant-selected space and activity; Kené, improvised material or risk cannot be isolated as exotic formal texture.

position_then_optics.answer: Participants choose the space and acceptable positions first. Start 35/50 mm within the agreed relation; 85 mm hidden-distance observation is prohibited.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Secure community/participant collaboration, explain competition use, permit withdrawal and final approval, compensate/credit as agreed, protect minors/locations and stop immediately without consent.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes only when community-approved architecture visibly enables collective agency and participants endorse the frame/submission. Outsider discovery, vulnerability or pattern extraction fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Community-selected public/collective space showing agreed route, threshold and gathering order
A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Agreed empty interval or participant-led use reveals structure
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude private homes, identifiers and exotic detail

B_HABITAR.position: Participant-selected productive/civic threshold with agreed framing
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No staged indigeneity, minors or product extraction
B_HABITAR.kill_trigger: Consent withdrawn or verb becomes performance for outsider

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Community-chosen reverse/side view that centers governance or service architecture rather than outsider overview
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No Kené extraction, poverty cue or official delegation pose

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Participant-selected space where light reveals an agreed architectural device supporting work/care
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Material never isolated as exotic texture

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Community-selected diagonal joining collective approach, architectural device and participant-led action
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Participants choose approach, exchange and collective verb
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Agency primary; protect identity/location as agreed
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Any consent, safety or representation concern
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.access_ethics: Community collaboration, withdrawal and final approval hard gates
